notes.title: New Mode & New Updates & 10% OFF Discount! Leaderboard Reset! Update RoadMap！
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44893788/e667de3efa2b566b9c06fd204f181cd0af76b615.jpg[/img]
[h2]New Discount Period[/h2]
The new [b]10% OFF [/b]discount period runs from November 5 to November 19.

[h2]New Mode:[/h2]
Adventure Mode: In each stage, Cat Gods will appear randomly, using their abilities to help animals earn coins. In this mode, the selection of external Cat Gods and toys is disabled. After feeding three Cat Gods, you’ll have a chance to choose an animal, toy, or Cat God.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44893788/89674380d5ad7b4f3b1307d5359775828cfe04ce.jpg[/img]
[h2]Enhancements:[/h2]
Lioness: Preys on 1 adjacent 【Hoofed Family】
Extra Wool: Increased chance to add a 【Lamb】 from 30% -> 50%
Black and White Paint: When 【Gazelle】 swaps places with 【Donkey】 or 【Horse】, transforms them into 【Zebra】; swapping with 【Zebra】 grants an additional +3 coins
Jumping Shoes: 【Gazelle】 and 【Zebra】 move to nearby empty spaces and gain +2 contribution when preyed upon
Golden Egg: Each animal of the same kind on the field gives the animal hatched from an 【Egg】 +1 contribution
Charge Horn: 【Cheetah】 gains +1 coin for each move
Coupon: After each shop reset, a random item’s price is reduced by 2
Milker: Cows reduce the growth days of nearby 【Calves】 and 【Lambs】 by 1

[h2]New Props:[/h2]
Cub Snack: Contribution doubles when baby animals mature
Grass Shed: Gain coins equal to the animal's contribution when removed
Meat Rack: When the 【Carnivore Family】 successfully preys, it drops 【Premium Leftovers】, which no longer takes up space
Couch Potato Sofa: Animals that did not leave the field the previous day gain +2 contribution

[h2]Leaderboard Reset[/h2]
All leaderboards have been reset

[h2]Update Roadmap[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44893788/72620453fbdc2b203278bc84271441ee4eb681b3.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Steam Next Fest Big Update! The Rodent Family is coming!
notes.notes:
Have a nice weekend, all the ranch managers! Long time no see!

I think you are a little tired of repeatedly challenging the current demo! So taking advantage of the Steam Next Fest, we will bring you a big update:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44893788/9413c314a3bdde5f5826733d839d74f46bb524d2.png[/img]

First of all, we would like to introduce the new animal family introduced in this update: the rodent family!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44893788/eb6ef9cda33e044c569d8401acff2bce72d150b5.png[/img]

This is a small animal family that can give birth and dig holes. The talent of giving birth allows them to quickly accumulate the number of tribes, and the characteristic of digging holes allows them to play in a super large scale in a single game, using the number to make more money for you!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44893788/b161950a2aa6f44d7829e4f404f9b454064453d1.png[/img]

In addition, along with the rodent family, there are also new carnivores such as owls, lynxes and minks that feed on them! These natural enemies of the rodent family will tirelessly hunt, earning money for you while also having unexpected effects!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44893788/63c6eef3d1a39d34114a849ae6817d150d714030.png[/img]

Finally, we have added more new props, illustration functions, new difficulties, new cat god and other content! I hope that these new contents can bring you a richer and more interesting experience during the New Product Festival and accompany you through this festival!

The following are the details of this update:
[h3]Contents available:[/h3]
[olist]
[*] Cat God available:
[list]
[*] New Cat God Joker
[/list]
[*] Families available:
[list]
[*] Rodent family
[/list]
[*] Animals available:
[list]
[*] Owl: Prey on all Pika families nearby, success: +2 contribution
[*] Gazelle: Exchange positions with the animal above, +2 gold coins
[*] Lynx: Prey on a Pika family nearby, success: +5 gold coins
[*] Marten: Prey on a Pika family nearby, success: +3 gold coins and move to the target location (up to 3 times)
[/list]
[*] Items available
[list]
[*] Owl House: After an owl eats 100 Pika families, it turns into a Terror Bird (inheriting contribution)
[*] Jerboa Tail: When jumping on the head of a pika family, it will gain 3 times the contribution
[*] Fitness Ring: +1 contribution for each movement of the animal
[*] Intensive Phobia Therapy Device: +1 gold coin for all pika families on the field
[*] Nirvana: If the animal on the field is not successfully eaten, +X gold coins (X is the number of animals that survived that day)
[*] Love House: Animals added by breeding can inherit contributions
[*] Sterilization Scissors: Bird families and pika families cannot lay eggs and breed
[*] Refresh Coupon: Free refresh of the store once per stage
[*] Remove Coupon: Free remove of the store once per stage
[*] Reset Coupon: Free reset of the store once per stage
[*] Welfare Lottery: Automatically removed after 10 days, and 0~10 cans are obtained
[*] Bank Card: For every 5 cans owned, an additional 1 interest is obtained
[*] Credit Card: The number of cans can be <0 (maximum debt 20)
[*] Gold Can: The selling price is equal to the current number of cans (maximum 50)

[*] Open difficulty:

[/list]
[*] Open race configuration function
[*] Open illustration function
[*] Open friend ranking function
[/olist]
[h3]Content adjustment:[/h3]
[olist]
[*] Props:
[list]
[*] Black market shop: -> -100 gold coins when selling, +6
[*] Canned net bag: -> Removed after 5 days and add a rare animal
[*] Piggy bank: +1 gold coin per day, 15 times gold coins immediately when selling

notes.title: Balance update, weekly ranking reset
notes.notes:
After everyone’s enthusiastic trial play during the replay fest week, we received a lot of feedback!
At the same time, we are also touched by everyone's enthusiasm for playing our demo and giving us feedback. We decided to update the demo again this week. The main purpose is to adjust the balance of the game and add certain operating methods. The update content is as follows:

[h2]Content adjustment:[/h2]
[h3]Economic adjustments:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Refresh cost: fixed at 1, no longer stacked with the number of refreshes
[*] Removal fee: fixed at 1 and no longer stacks with the number of removals
[*] Initial cans: The initial number of cans is adjusted to 3
[*] New addition to the store: lock function
[/list]
[h3]Animal adjustments:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Chick: -> can grow into a turkey
[*] Fox: -> can prey on turkeys by default
[*] Cub: Contributions will be inherited after growing up
[/list]
[h3]Items adjustment:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Grill: Extra +4 gold coins when the turkey is eaten
[*] Piggy Bank: Get +4 gold coins every day
[*] Secret Letter: Choose a rare (green) animal to join
[*] Tiger Seal: Every time a tiger eats an animal, it adds +1 contribution.
[*] Magpie's Nest: Extra +1 contribution when magpie skill is triggered
[*] Alpaca Hat, Broken Mirror: rarity adjusted to rare (blue)
[*] Grudge Shop: Sells the animal with the lowest rarity, and adjusts its rarity to rare (blue)
[/list]
[h2]Bug fixes:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug where the money progress bar sometimes gets stuck in the stage
[*] Fixed the bug of incorrect refresh probability after loading archives
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44893788/c2a1b53a0434148b88005eb0eb0ab70905c921df.jpg[/img]
In addition, the rankings will also be reset weekly, and the top player: “[b]深禽呀[/b]”，[b]If you see this, you can join our player group as soon as possible and contact the administrator to obtain the qualification for customized cat god skin, otherwise this opportunity will be wasted.[/b]

Welcome everyone to experience this update and give us feedback and suggestions!

[b]If you like our game, please remember to add it to your wishlist so you won’t miss out on future updates, events and the launch of the official version![/b]

notes.title: Endless Replayability Steam Fest Demo Update!
notes.notes:
It's been two weeks since we released our demo, and I think everyone's become quite proficient with ranch management and keeping the Cat God happy. Thank you all for loving our game!
We've received a lot of feedback from players, so here's both a major update to the demo as we continue on into the Endless Replayability Steam Fest!

We'll be updating our demo all the way up to game launch, so remember to wishlist so you can keep playing!

If you have any questions or feedback, follow us on [url=https://www.twitter.com/catgodranch]Twitter[/url] or join our [url=https://discord.gg/XhdeNmurmj]Discord[/url]! 

[h1]Demo Updates[/h1]

[h2]Leaderboards[/h2]
[img]https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/44893788/5bfe0195e06b94a9e63e4c9a67fcc51639757a8e.png[/img]
The leaderboard will reset on May 14, 2024. The top player at the end of the ranking period will receive a special Cat God skin. This skin can only be won once by each player, so if you've won before, we hope you'll still play for fun :D 

To the player ELEVEN who won our last leaderboard challenge, please join our Discord so you can claim your custom skin prize!

[h2]New Content[/h2]
[*] Added animals: [b]Saber-toothed Tiger[/b] & [b]Snow Leopard[/b]
[*] Added a new Cat God, Lilia, with the ability to choose to protect an animal from being removed, sold, or eaten. 
[*] Added new props: Training Leash, Golden Bamboo
[/list]
[img]https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/44893788/ba50913c23d02ad46c458e7a45f202b8f73f452a.jpg[/img]
[h2]Balance Changes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Sheepdog now earns 4 gold for every time it protects an animal, up from 2 gold
[*] Emperor Penguin now travels for 4 days and brings back 1 item on return
[*] Elk has been nerfed: X upper limit of 6 is now 3
[*] Magpie now has +1 contribution for every 3 or more identical birds on the field
[*] Lv1 carnivores now get +1 more gold when eating an animal; Lv3 carnivores receive the Predation ability. High rarity carnivores can also now eat low rarity carnivores and inherit their gold generation abilities.
[*] Hoofed animals added at Lv3 can inherit gold generation abilities
[*] Added extra stage in Lv2 Difficulty. There are now 10 stages.
[*] Achievements can now only be unlocked after you complete Lv2 Difficulty.
[/list]
[h2]Optimisations and Bugfixes
[/h2]
[list]
[*] Optimised some descriptions
[*] Optimised how the cooldown time of Cat God skills is displayed
[*] Added Esc and Space shortcuts
[*] Fixed a bug where animals cannot be removed
[*] Fixed grass-related bigs
[*] Fixed the ranch display bug
[*] Fixed multiple gold generation bugs
[/list]

[/list]
